name: Loominal
tagline: Answers a new engineer's 'why' questions with sources from Slack, GitHub, Linear and Notion.
problem: New engineers drown in scattered tribal knowledge across tools.
solution: Integrates workplace tools, indexes them with embeddings in Postgres, and answers questions with cited sources through an agent.
demo_moment: Team-described: ask why a PR was reverted and get the thread and ticket.

why_it_stood_out.claim: Won “Linear: Best Agents of Linear” among 131 submissions.
Tells the story through a named persona.

lessons: A persona with a specific first week makes a knowledge tool concrete.
